entities.name: Kiran Nalaar
entities.description: Inventor, father of Chandra Nalaar and husband of Pia Nalaar, killed by Consulate troops.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Fire mage daughter of Kiran and Pia.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: Inventor wife of Kiran, jailed after Burarat burned.

entities.name: Burarat
entities.description: Village hiding place burned down by Consulate troops.

entities.name: Captain Baral
entities.description: Consulate captain whose troops burned Burarat.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: Ghirapur government forces hunting the fire mage.

entities.name: Echoverse
entities.description: Alternate reality where Kiran helped run the Consulate.

events.summary: Discovering Chandra is a fire mage, Kiran and Pia flee Ghirapur to escape the Consulate.
events.quote: they fled Ghirapur to escape the Consulate forces

events.summary: Captain Baral's troops burn down Burarat; Kiran is killed, Chandra taken to be executed, Pia jailed.
events.quote: Kiran was killed, Chandra was taken away to be executed and Pia was jailed.

relations.quote: Kiran Nalaar was the father of Chandra Nalaar

relations.note: His troops burned Burarat and Kiran was killed.
relations.quote: burned down by the troops of Captain Baral
